name: A Crumpled Up Note
label: Quest
description: A Crumpled Up Note: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The note has stains covering its surface. The text is barely legible, but you make out the following:
...if it were not for General Angerforge's diligence, we may have never discovered the pattern to the encryption...
...Argelmach is almost done with the decryption of Windsor's notes.
Our lord will rise from the depths and crush any that remain...

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you have there, friend?
